summary: Pop Culture Group Co., Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a registered direct offering of 7,448,000 Class A ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants for up to 45,885,333 additional shares, priced at $0.15 per share-equivalent, raising net proceeds of ~$6.67 million. The pre-funded warrants are exercisable at $0.01 per share, subject to a 9.99% beneficial ownership limitation. Univest Securities acted as placement agent, receiving a 7% cash fee and a 12-month right of first refusal. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
